legend: The Green Children of Woolpit (Suffolk, England, 12th-century legend)
lines: Woolpit, England, twelfth century. It is harvest time in a quiet village.
The farmers hear a strange noise near the old wolf pits.
Out of a pit stumble two children, a boy and a girl.
Their skin is green, and they speak a language nobody knows.
They refuse all food, except raw green beans.
Slowly the girl learns English, and her skin turns normal.
She says they came from a land without a sun, only twilight.
They followed the sound of bells, and suddenly they were here.
A lost world below the earth, or two frightened children?
title: Two Green Children Crawled Out of a Pit in Medieval England #shorts
description:
In 12th-century Woolpit, two green-skinned children appeared from a wolf pit and spoke an unknown language. A strange old English legend.
